title: Software Engineer
description:
Company: Fraud Deflect

Role: Mid-Level — Software Engineer

Language: Native/fluent English (resumes in English)


About the role

Build and migrate backend and integration code from PHP/JavaScript into Python services. You’ll work on business logic, APIs/integrations, and data access, with light Linux operations and a strong focus on clarity, communication, and asking the right questions.


Responsibilities

  • Migrate existing PHP + JavaScript functionality into Python services (maintain behavior, improve structure, add tests).
  • Implement backend features and business logic with solid programming fundamentals.
  • Write and maintain SQL queries (data access, reporting, validations).
  • Run/debug scripts and jobs on Linux servers (SSH, logs, scheduled executions).
  • Contribute to code reviews; surface failures/risks early and propose fixes.
  • Collaborate with teammates and stakeholders: clarify requirements, ask questions, document decisions.
  • Support workflows/pipelines using Airflow or similar orchestration tools.


Required

  • Working proficiency in PHP and JavaScript and interest/ability to migrate to Python (required).
  • Strong programming logic and problem-solving skills.
  • Comfortable using Linux servers for connections and executions (SSH, basic troubleshooting).
  • SQL knowledge (able to read/write queries and understand schemas).
  • Clear communication; proactive in asking questions and calling out issues.


Nice to have

  • Airflow (or similar orchestrators like Prefect/Dagster).
  • Experience working with APIs and integrations.


How to apply

Send an English resume and links to APIs/code/docs showing Python, SQL, automation, and payments/chargebacks work.

title: Talent Pool - Persons with Disabilities (Banco de Talentos - PcD)
description:
About Revolut


People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 70+ million customers get more from their money every day.


As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


Diversity is how we build better

Diversity at Revolut drives better ideas, bolder thinking, and a more inclusive future. We’re committed to increasing representation, especially for people with disabilities who remain underrepresented in tech. That means removing barriers, opening doors, and creating access to opportunity so everyone can contribute, grow, and shape what's next in finance.


Areas we commonly hire for in Brazil


  • Audit
  • Data Analysis
  • Engineering
  • Legal
  • Risk
  • Finance
  • FinCrime
  • Operations
  • Product
  • Recruitment
  • Tax


If you don’t see your area listed above but believe your profile could be a good fit for Revolut, you’re also welcome to apply.


This is a dedicated talent track to support the inclusion of professionals with disabilities.

We move fast and we move together. Real innovation starts with representation, and we’re building a team where different abilities and perspectives are welcomed and valued.


If you apply through this channel, our Talent Acquisition team will review your profile with care. When we find a potential fit with an open role, we’ll reach out to connect you with the next steps in our hiring process.


Who can apply through this channel?

We welcome professionals with disabilities to apply through this channel or any other open roles on our careers page. This is a proactive way for us to discover diverse talent. If your profile matches an open position, our team will reach out to guide you through the next steps in the hiring process.


Can I apply if I don’t identify as a person with a disability?

This channel is specifically designed to connect with talented professionals with disabilities who want to grow their careers with Revolut. If this doesn’t describe you, please check out the range of opportunities on our careers page.


Why is Revolut breaking barriers to hire persons with disabilities in Brazil?

Our Revoluters are our priority. That’s why in 2021 we launched our D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive everyday. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.


Does applying here mean I’m automatically part of the recruitment process?

When you apply through this platform, our team will carefully review every profile. If your skills and experience align with a current opportunity, we’ll reach out to invite you to the next stage of our hiring process.


What if I'm not based in São Paulo? Can I still apply?

Yes. Revolut is a remote-first company that hires talent across Brazil and beyond. Our recruitment and onboarding are designed to be fully remote, and we embrace flexible work arrangements tailored to the role and business needs.


What you’ll need

  • Fluency in English
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Great problem-solving skills
  • Experience in a fast-paced working environment
  • The ability to communicate confidently across all levels
  • A self-starter attitude
  • A solid sense of ownership and ability to work independently
  • High attention to detail


Nice to have

  • Fluency in other languages
  • Practical knowledge of Google Suite


Important notice for candidates:


Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles:

title: Analytics Architect
description:
Responsibilities:

  • Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of advanced analytics solutions using Azure Databricks/ Fabric. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of big data technologies, data engineering, and cloud computing, with a strong focus on Azure Databricks along with Strong SQL.
  • Work closely with business stakeholders and other IT teams to understand requirements and deliver effective solutions.
  • Oversee the end-to-end implementation of data solutions, ensuring alignment with business requirements and best practices.
  • Lead the development of data pipelines and ETL processes using Azure Databricks, PySpark, and other relevant tools.
  • Integrate Azure Databricks with other Azure services (e.g., Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse, Azure Data Factory) and on-premise systems .
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to the data engineering team, fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement.
  • Ensure proper documentation of architecture, processes, and data flows, while ensuring compliance with security and governance standards.
  • Ensure best practices are followed in terms of code quality, data security, and scalability.
  • Stay updated with the latest developments in Databricks and associated technologies to drive innovation.


Essential Skills:

  • Strong experience with Azure Databricks , including cluster management, notebook development, and Delta Lake.
  • Proficiency in big data technologies (e.g., Hadoop, Spark) and data processing frameworks (e.g., PySpark).
  • Deep understanding of Azure services like Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse, and Azure Data Factory. Power BI, SSRS, SSAS, PSKU to F SKU.
  • Experience with ETL/ELT processes, data warehousing, and building data lakes.
  • Strong SQL skills and familiarity with NoSQL databases.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and version control systems like Git.
  • Knowledge of cloud security best practices.


Soft Skills:

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues.
  • Leadership skills with the ability to manage and mentor a team of data engineers.


Nice to have Skills:

  • Power BI for dashboarding and reporting.
  • Microsoft Fabric for analytics and integration tasks.
  • Spark Streaming for processing real-time data streams.
  • Familiarity with Azure Resource Manager (ARM) templates for infrastructure as code (IaC) practices.


Experience:

1. Demonstrated expertise of 12+ years in developing data ingestion and transformation pipelines using Databricks/Synapse notebooks and Azure Data Factory.

2. Solid understanding and hands-on experience with Delta tables, Delta Lake, and Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2.

3. Experience in efficiently using Auto Loader and Delta Live tables for seamless data ingestion and transformation.

4. Proficiency in building and optimizing query layers using Databricks SQL.

5. Demonstrated experience integrating Databricks with Azure Synapse, ADLS Gen2, and Power BI for end-to-end analytics solutions.

6. Prior experience in developing, optimizing, and deploying Power BI reports.

7. Familiarity with modern CI/CD practices, especially in the context of Databricks and cloud-native solutions.

title: U.S. Immigration Paralegal/Case Manager
description:
Company Description


Robinson Immigration Law is a boutique U.S. immigration law firm based in Nashville, Tennessee, serving clients across the United States and globally with 100% remote capability. The firm focuses on high-skill, business, and investment-based immigration, working with founders, executives, researchers, creatives, and investors looking to build their lives and careers in the U.S. With expertise in pathways such as EB-1A, EB-2 NIW, O-1A, and E-2, Robinson Immigration Law prioritizes thoughtful positioning and effective solutions to achieve durable immigration outcomes.


Role Description


This is a full-time, remote role for an Immigration Case Manager (Paralegal), with a focus on visas including the EB-1A, EB-2 NIW, O-1, and E-2.


The case manager will assist in immigration case preparation, including conducting legal research, drafting support letters, and completing immigration forms. Responsibilities include communicating with clients to gather necessary documents, providing updates on case status, and maintaining accurate and organized electronic filing systems. The role also involves calendaring deadlines, ensuring timely submissions, and collaborating directly with attorneys to ensure a smooth and efficient case process.


Qualifications


  • Strong legal research, case management, and document preparation skills
  • Experience in drafting professional correspondence and support letters
  • Excellent organizational, time management, and attention-to-detail capabilities
  • Well-developed communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to interact professionally with clients
  • Proficiency in legal or office software systems and tools
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment and manage multiple tasks or deadlines
  • Prior experience in immigration law, particularly with employment-based or investment-based visa processes, is highly preferred


We offer a supportive and collaborative team environment, competitive salary and vacation, and opportunities for learning and advancement.


We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Remote Biomedical Informatics SME - 58854
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

We are seeking highly skilled Biomedical Informatics Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to join our team in developing rigorous, high-quality evaluation questions designed to assess and challenge advanced AI models. The primary objective is to create benchmark questions that test the boundaries of AI capabilities across diverse bioinformatics domains.

This role requires deep technical expertise combined with the ability to craft precise, unambiguous questions with well-defined evaluations. The ideal candidate will possess not only strong theoretical knowledge but also practical experience in designing assessment materials that have deterministic, verifiable outcomes.


Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop challenging bioinformatics coding questions that push the limits of AI model capabilities.
  • Create automated, coding-based evaluations with unit tests that objectively verify correctness.
  • Build comprehensive evaluation rubrics with 7–10 distinct criteria for each bioinformatics question.
  • Ensure every question is self-contained, well-defined, and completely unambiguous, including all domain rules and edge cases.
  • Develop problems where there is exactly one correct answer or outcome that can be deterministically validated.
  • Translate theoretical bioinformatics concepts into concrete, measurable outputs.
  • Enforce performance requirements with explicit constraints and tests to prevent inefficient or brute-force solutions.


Required Qualifications:

Educational Background

  • Master's degree of experience in biomedical data processing and interpretation.
  • Ongoing PhD with 3+ years of experience in biomedical data processing and interpretation.
  • PhD (completed) in Biomedical Informatics, Bioinformatics, Computational Biology or a closely related field (preferred).


Technical and other skills

  • Strong proficiency in biomedical data processing, analysis, and interpretation , including working with large‑scale datasets.
  • Experience with bioinformatics tools and pipelines (e.g., NGS workflows, multi‑omics, etc.).
  • Solid programming skills in Python / R
  • Experience working in Linux/Unix , Docker and version control.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills for working in interdisciplinary research teams


Domain Expertise Requirements

Candidates must demonstrate deep, expert-level knowledge in at least TWO (2) of the following five core bioinformatics domains:

1. Biomedical Image Processing

  • Processing of Radiology imaging: CT, MRI, PET/SPECT, Ultrasound imaging
  • Automating cell counting, identifying cell types, and analyzing tissue structures in pathology slides
  • Computational segmentation and boundary inference
  • Medical image formation, reconstruction & enhancement
  • Noise modeling and statistical denoising
  • Image sampling theory and resolution limits
  • Intensity standardization and harmonization
  • Geometric transformations and spatial calibration
  • Multi-modal image registration and alignment
  • Morphological and topological shape analysis
  • Quantitative imaging feature extraction
  • Fusing data from different modalities (MRI, PET, Genomics) for a comprehensive view to tailor treatments
  • pattern recognition and predictive modeling

2. Biomedical Signal Processing

  • Cardiovascular/hemodynamic signals (ECG, PPG, BP, HRV, etc)
  • Neural/brain electrical signals (EEG, EP/ERP; seizure/cognitive analysis)
  • Neuromuscular/motor signals (EMG, motor unit decomposition; prosthetics/rehab)
  • Ocular/visual system signals (EOG, blink/saccade analysis)
  • Respiratory signals (airflow, effort; sleep/disordered breathing)
  • Nonlinear, Statistical, and Adaptive Signal Analysis
  • Multichannel, Spatial, and Connectivity Signal Analysis
  • Machine Learning and Data‑Driven Biomedical Signal Analysis
  • Clinical Monitoring, Wearable, and Translational Signal Processing

3. Molecular & Omics based Personalized Medicine

  • Omics based risk / disease prediction (GWAS, PRS, bulk, single‑cell RNA‑seq, proteins / metabolite signatures associated with diseases)
  • Risk Prediction and Prognosis Modeling
  • Molecular patient subtyping
  • Liquid Biopsy and Circulating Biomarkers (ctDNA, cfRNA/miRNA, MRD, etc.)
  • Causal Inference & Mechanistic Inference (ATE/CATE, Trial emulation and counterfactual modeling)
  • Cross‑modal data fusion (omics + EHR + imaging / signals)
  • Longitudinal Patient Modeling and Disease Progression
  • Patient Stratification and Subtyping (molecular subtypes, endotypes)
  • Electronic Health Records and Clinical Data Science

4. Drug Discovery & Repurposing

  • Treatment response prediction
  • Structure-based drug design (Molecular docking, binding site analysis, Virtual screening workflow)
  • Protein structure analysis (PDB/mmCIF handling)
  • Chemoinformatics ( Ligand-based screening, molecular fingerprinting, 2D/3D data handling and chemical space analysis)
  • QSAR & ADMET Modeling
  • Drug–target interaction prediction
  • Drug sensitivity prediction in disease models
  • Repurposing via omics/network associations
  • Predictive Modeling for Drug Discovery Molecular Dynamics Simulation of Biomolecules (QM, DFT, stability, reactivity, PCA analysis )

5. Software / Utilities

  • Tool installation & environment management (docker/conda/pip)
  • Format conversion/validation (FASTA/FASTQ, BAM/VCF, PDB)
  • GUI-driven analysis workflows (step-by-step runs)
  • Workflow automation (scripts wrapping GUI tools)
  • Visualization tools (genome browsers, 3D viewers)
  • Container/VM execution and troubleshooting
  • Batch processing and report generation
  • Pipeline interoperability checks
  • Reproducibility packaging (configs, manifests)
  • Debugging typical bioinformatics tool errors

6. Regulatory Science and Clinical Policies

  • FDA/EMA regulatory pathways
  • Clinical Practice Guidelines & Standards of Care (e.g., NCCN, AHA, etc.)
  • Diagnostic Biomarker & Therapeutic Use Constraints
  • Medical Scenario Reasoning (case vignettes, Differential diagnosis)
  • Data & Content Compliance
  • Ethical Use, Safety, and Harm Prevention
  • Model Use Governance & Auditability
  • Policy‑Aligned Language & Communication
  • Clinical validation and cohort generalization
  • Privacy‑preserving learning


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : At least 30 hours per week. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 2 months; (expected start date is next week)


Evaluation Process:

  • Take home Assessment on Biomedical Informatics (2-6 hours)
  • Delivery discussion(15-30mins)

title: Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer (Python & AI/ML) – Full-Time, Remote
description:
Senior Software Engineer (Python & AI/ML)


Company: GTG LLC

Company Stage: Startup / Growth-Stage

Location: Remote

Experience Level: Senior (7+ years)


About the Role


GTG LLC is a growing startup building intelligent, scalable software solutions. We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer with deep expertise in Python and AI/ML engineering, who is also comfortable operating across the full stack.


This role is ideal for someone who enjoys ownership, moving fast, and solving complex technical problems in an early-stage environment. You will work closely with founders and key stakeholders to design, build, and scale backend systems, AI-driven services, and modern web applications.


Key Responsibilities


 - Design, develop, and maintain backend services using Python and frameworks such as Flask, Django, and FastAPI

 - Build and integrate AI/ML solutions, including model deployment, inference pipelines, and data processing workflows

 - Architect and maintain RESTful APIs with strong performance, scalability, and reliability

 - Collaborate on frontend development using modern JavaScript frameworks such as React, Next.js, Angular, or Vue

 - Contribute to overall system architecture, technical decisions, and engineering best practices

 - Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines to ensure reliable deployments and high code quality

 - Work across the full product lifecycle, from early design and prototyping to production support

 - Identify technical gaps and proactively propose and implement solutions


Required Qualifications


 - 7+ years of professional experience as a Software Engineer or similar senior-level role

 - C1 or higher English proficiency (mandatory) — strong verbal and written communication skills

 - Deep expertise in Python and backend development

 - Hands-on experience with Flask, Django, and/or FastAPI

 - Strong background in AI/ML engineering, including production-level model integration and deployment

 - Proficiency with modern JavaScript frameworks (React, Next.js, Angular, or Vue)

 - Cloud experience with AWS or Azure (required)

 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines, version control, and production deployment workflows

 - Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently in a fast-paced startup environment


Nice to Have


 - Experience with Java or C#, or proficiency in more than one backend programming language

 - Experience with GCP in addition to AWS or Azure

 - Prior experience working in early-stage or fast-moving startups


What We Offer


 - Opportunity to play a key technical role in a growing startup

 - High level of ownership and influence over architecture and product direction

 - Fully remote and flexible work environment

 - Competitive compensation, based on experience and skill level

title: Analista de implementação Bitrix24
description:
(IMPORTANTE: Já ter atuado com Bitrix24 e n8n são requisítos mínimos.)


Somos uma empresa pioneira em soluções tecnológicas que combinam implementações Bitrix24 com inteligência artificial avançada. Estamos na vanguarda da criação de agentes de IA e automações inteligentes que revolucionam processos empresariais. Nosso diferencial está no desenvolvimento de soluções personalizadas potencializadas por IA que transformam radicalmente a operação de nossos clientes, oferecendo eficiência e inovação através da combinação de Bitrix24, n8n e modelos avançados de linguagem (LLMs).


A Oportunidade

Estamos em busca de um talento que irá atuar majoritariamente em nossas implementações Bitrix24 e o auxiliar nos desenvolvimento soluções de IA, contribuindo diretamente para o crescimento da empresa em um momento crucial de expansão. Esta é sua chance de fazer parte de uma equipe inovadora que está na fronteira da tecnologia, criando agentes de IA personalizados e redefinindo o uso de ferramentas empresariais com inteligência artificial avançada.


Suas Responsabilidades:

Implementações Bitrix24 de Excelência

- Trabalhar diretamente com nossos clientes nas implementações Bitrix24

- Participar ativamente de calls para entendimento de projetos e requisitos

- Manter comunicação constante com os clientes durante todo o ciclo de implementação

- Desenvolver automações customizadas que transformam processos empresariais

- Realizar configurações e customizações avançadas na plataforma

- Fornecer suporte técnico especializado, garantindo a satisfação contínua dos clientes


Integrações Avançadas com n8n

- Criar fluxos de integração perfeitos entre sistemas de terceiros e o Bitrix24

- Utilizar o n8n como ferramenta principal para construção de integrações robustas

- Otimizar processos através de integrações entre múltiplas plataformas

- Possuir domínio da ferramenta para conseguir analisar e interpretar workflows já existentes


Será um diferencial se você:

- Construir agentes de IA inovadores utilizando LLMs através do n8n

- Desenvolver, testar e refinar prompts para aplicações de IA

- Implementar soluções de inteligência artificial que tragam resultados mensuráveis para nossos clientes


Crescimento Real

- Oportunidade de crescimento em uma empresa em expansão

- Potencial para assumir posições de liderança à medida que crescemos

- Participação ativa nas decisões estratégicas da empresa


Perfil Que Buscamos

Procuramos alguém que vista a camisa da empresa e tenha verdadeira \"dor de dono\". Como parte de um time enxuto e altamente colaborativo, você terá a oportunidade de participar ativamente de todas as atividades da empresa, contribuindo em múltiplas frentes e desenvolvendo uma visão completa do negócio.

Valorizamos profissionais com excelente comunicação e habilidade para construir relacionamentos de confiança com os clientes. Você atuará como o principal ponto de contato técnico, representando nossa empresa em reuniões, calls de alinhamento e apresentações de soluções, sendo fundamental sua capacidade de entender as necessidades dos clientes e transformá-las em implementações eficientes.


Faça Parte da Nossa História

Esta não é apenas uma vaga de trabalho – é uma oportunidade de fazer parte de algo especial desde o início. Se você é apaixonado por tecnologia, tem experiência com Bitrix24, n8n e está animado com as possibilidades da IA, queremos conhecer você!

description:

Conduzir processos de treinamento desde o levantamento das necessidades até a condução coordenando budget de acordo com o plano;


Atender auditorias e fiscalizações;


Auxiliar na integração de novos colaboradores, preparando materiais de boas-vindas e acompanhando treinamentos iniciais, sempre que necessário;


Atualizar cadastros e informações de empregados em sistemas de RH, continuamente;


Apoiar rotinas de folha de pagamento, coletando informações de ponto e benefícios;


Auxiliar na gestão de benefícios, realizando cadastros, alterações e atendimento a colaboradores, conforme demanda;


Apoiar a organização de treinamentos internos e externos, controlando listas de presença e avaliações;


Elaborar e analisar indicadores e relatórios de RH, apoiando a consolidação de dados;


Apoiar campanhas internas e de engajamento, participando de eventos internos, conforme calendário corporativo;


Ser focal point para processos de comunicação;


Participar do programa de desenvolvimento de pessoas e de líderes , fazendo parte da construção do plano anual;


Apoiar atividades de Relações Trabalhistas e compliance;


Atender colaboradores em dúvidas relacionadas a políticas de RH, benefícios e procedimentos;


Zelar pela confidencialidade e integridade das informações de colaboradores, em todas as rotinas de RH

Experiência em chão de fábrica e segmento automotivo e autopeças será um diferencial.

Ensino Superior Completo em Administração, Psicologia ou Gestão de RH;


Experiência em segmento fabril, automotivo e autopeças, será considerado um diferencial;


Importante já ter atuado com processos seletivos de alto volume, preferencialmente no ramo automotivo;


Pacote Office Avançado;


Disponibilidade para atuar 100% presencial, na cidade de Caçapava/SP.

A (o) profissional será responsável por conduzir processos de recrutamento e seleção, divulgando vagas, triando currículos e agendando entrevistas, diariamente;


Conduzir processos de treinamento desde o levantamento das necessidades até a condução coordenando budget de acordo com o plano;


Atender auditorias e fiscalizações;


Auxiliar na integração de novos colaboradores, preparando materiais de boas-vindas e acompanhando treinamentos iniciais, sempre que necessário;


Atualizar cadastros e informações de empregados em sistemas de RH, continuamente;


Apoiar rotinas de folha de pagamento, coletando informações de ponto e benefícios;


Auxiliar na gestão de benefícios, realizando cadastros, alterações e atendimento a colaboradores, conforme demanda;


Apoiar a organização de treinamentos internos e externos, controlando listas de presença e avaliações;


Elaborar e analisar indicadores e relatórios de RH, apoiando a consolidação de dados;


Apoiar campanhas internas e de engajamento, participando de eventos internos, conforme calendário corporativo;


Ser focal point para processos de comunicação;


Participar do programa de desenvolvimento de pessoas e de líderes , fazendo parte da construção do plano anual;


Apoiar atividades de Relações Trabalhistas e compliance;


Atender colaboradores em dúvidas relacionadas a políticas de RH, benefícios e procedimentos;


Zelar pela confidencialidade e integridade das informações de colaboradores, em todas as rotinas de RH

title: Analista de empréstimo
description:
About Monee

At Monee, we believe that every team member is essential to our success — and that diversity of perspectives and experiences is key to driving our business and advancing our purpose of changing the world for the better.

Being part of our team means growing within a fast-paced and agile culture. If you love taking on big responsibilities and doing what has never been done before, Monee is the place for you.

Here, you’ll face meaningful challenges, collaborate with a diverse team, and help shape the future of the fintech industry in Brazil — creating a positive impact in the lives of millions.

Work Model

We adopt a hybrid work model, this model allows people to adjust their work environment according to their personal needs, while promoting collaboration and interaction in the office.



What will be your mission?

Planning and execution of projects related to credit products, including participation in and development of initiatives focused on identifying business opportunities, conducting in-depth analyses, and implementing new solutions. Creation of strategic initiatives aimed at driving growth and cost reduction. Leadership of workstreams within high-impact projects in a fast-paced environment, ensuring concrete and tangible deliverables. Ongoing interaction with teams across different areas and countries, as well as direct collaboration with multiple internal stakeholders and external partners.


What will your day-to-day be like?

  • Build and launch new credit products (with focus on consumer) while monitoring the results of current product portfolio;
  • Identify business opportunities, conduct in-depth analysis, and implement new solutions;
  • Prepare and present business cases to both local and international audiences
  • Own and deliver strategic and tactical initiatives to drive growth and cost reduction;
  • Lead workstreams in high-impact projects in a fast-paced environment, with concrete and tangible deliverables;
  • Interact with teams from different areas and countries. Work closely with the SG SeaMoney team.
  • High exposure to top management.



What you need to take on the challenge:

  • Experience in Credit Products for Consumers (BNPL, Personal Loan, Secured Credit etc.)
  • Advanced English (speaking, reading, and writing is mandatory);
  • Hands-on profile, ability to think strategically;
  • Data-drive profile, being capable of dealing with complex models and analysis;
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to interact with cross-functional teams and external

stakeholders;

  • Able to work in a fast-paced environment.

  • Medical and dental care, extended to dependents;
  • Partnership with Gympass and TotalPass;
  • Flexible meal/food vouchers;
  • Transportation vouchers, mobility vouchers or on-site parking;
  • Flexible benefits;
  • Zenklub;
  • Discretionary annual bonus, linked to performance.

title: MS D365 CRM Functional Consultant
description:
We never request payment at any stage of our recruitment process, and we only contact candidates through official corporate accounts and platforms. If you are approached with any request for payment, it is likely fraudulent. Please verify whether the role you are interested in is posted on our official website.



About TMF Group

TMF Group is a leading global provider of high-value business services to clients operating and investing worldwide. We deliver specialized, business‑critical financial and administrative services that enable our clients to operate their corporate structures, finance vehicles and investment funds across multiple jurisdictions.



Discover the Role

We are seeking a CRM Business Analyst / CRM Functional Consultant who will play a key role in gathering business requirements and supporting implementations of Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365) . The ideal candidate is resourceful, detail‑oriented, self‑driven and committed to deeply understanding business needs and translating them into effective technical solutions.

Strong listening skills, collaboration, openness to feedback and a sense of ownership are essential to success in this role. If you are driven by challenge, enjoy going the extra mile and want to work with highly talented professionals, this is the opportunity for you.

If you are an experienced Microsoft D365 CRM Functional Consultant seeking dynamic projects and a collaborative team, we encourage you to apply.



Key Responsibilities

  • Gather and document business requirements in collaboration with stakeholders.
  • Implement Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM solutions tailored to business needs.
  • Configure and customize D365 CRM to meet functional requirements.
  • Work closely with technical teams to integrate CRM with other systems.
  • Participate in project planning, estimating and project management activities.
  • Deliver end‑user training and provide ongoing functional support.
  • Maintain up‑to‑date knowledge of new D365 CRM features and capabilities.
  • Mentor and guide junior consultants when needed.


Key Requirements

  • Experience in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM implementation and customization.
  • Experience with version 8.0 or later.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Experience developing custom workflows, entities and plugins using C# or .NET .
  • Strong understanding of D365 CRM’s data model, security model and configuration options.
  • Excellent analytical, problem‑solving and critical‑thinking skills.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently or in a team environment.



What’s in It for You?

Career Development

  • Opportunities for internal mobility and career progression.
  • Collaboration with global colleagues and exposure to international clients.
  • Continuous learning supported by the TMF Business Academy.

Making an Impact

  • Direct contribution to simplifying global business operations for our clients.
  • Opportunities to support local communities through our corporate social responsibility initiatives.

A Supportive Environment

  • A strong feedback culture that supports growth and engagement.
  • Flexibility to work from our offices or remotely, promoting work‑life balance.
  • An inclusive environment where people are empowered and encouraged to grow their careers.

At TMF Group, our people define who we are . We thrive on entrepreneurial spirit and value proactive professionals who bring passion, accountability and excellence to everything they do.

Estamos em expansão no Brasil e buscamos profissionais comprometidos e que enxerguem na expansão uma oportunidade de construir e transformar.

  • Especialista de Barter

  • Construir e manter relacionamento próximo com tradings e demais parceiros de Barter, garantindo alternativas competitivas de originação;

title: Desenvolvedor(a) .Net + Angular Sênior
description:
Quem somos nós?


Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.


Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .


Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:


  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?


Como .NET Developer na Builders você irá atuar no desenvolvimento de plataforma, produzindo e otimizando códigos para maior performance, escalabilidade e velocidade. Será responsável pela qualidade e funcionalidade das soluções implementadas.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa dominar:


  • Plataforma .NET Core (C#): Sólido conhecimento no desenvolvimento de aplicações utilizando .NET Core.
  • Angular: Experiência prática no desenvolvimento de interfaces com o framework Angular.
  • APIs Web (WebApi): Domínio na criação, consumo e manutenção de APIs RESTful.
  • Bancos de Dados: Conhecimento em bancos relacionais e não relacionais, como SQL Server, MongoDB e Oracle.
  • Testes Automatizados: Experiência na criação de testes de unidade e de integração utilizando ferramentas como xUnit, Moq ou NSubstitute.
  • Controle de Versão: Familiaridade com Git para versionamento de código.
  • Arquitetura de Software e Padrões de Projeto: Conhecimento em DDD (Domain-Driven Design), Design Patterns, arquitetura orientada a eventos (Event-Driven Architecture), microsserviços e práticas de integração e entrega contínua (CI/CD).
  • Boas Práticas de Desenvolvimento: Aplicação de princípios como Clean Code, SOLID, DRY (Don't Repeat Yourself), KISS (Keep It Simple, Stupid) e YAGNI (You Aren’t Gonna Need It).
  • Containers: Conhecimento em Docker para criação e gerenciamento de ambientes isolados.


Será um diferencial se você tiver também:


  • Conhecimento em tecnologias legadas para projetos de migração: Socket, SOAP;
  • Familiaridade com Práticas Ágeis;
  • Mensageria (RabbitMq, Azure Service Bus).


O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?

  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;
  • Auxílio Home-Office no cartão Caju;
  • Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju - um valor fléxivel para você usar como você quiser;
  • Plano de Saúde Nacional Porto Seguro (Plano Prata com apartamento e sem coparticipação) com 50% da mensalidade custeada pela Builders;
  • Assistência Odontológica pela Porto Seguro (Plano Bronze) com 100% da mensalidade paga pela Builders;
  • Auxílio Creche para crianças de até 72 meses;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Mental - acesso ao aplicativo Vida+;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Física - acesso ao aplicativo Gympass;
  • Seguro de vida.


Todas as nossas vagas são inclusivas e abertas a pessoas de todas as identidades de gênero, orientações sexuais, idades, etnias, culturas, origens, crenças, deficiências e outras diversidades. Acreditamos que a pluralidade enriquece nosso time e promove um ambiente de trabalho mais inovador e colaborativo.

title: Lead Java Developer - Relocation to Portugal
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • More than 10 years as a Back-End Developer with Java;
  • Experience with the latest versions of Java;
  • Solid experience with Spring Boot, Terraform, Kubernetes, Kafka, GraphQL and GitHub;
  • Work experience with Microsoft Cloud Azure;
  • Experience with leading complex initiatives and the collaboration with other teams to agree technical designs - Mandatory ;
  • Experience with Coaching and mentoring more junior engineers, influencing and improving the engineering practices within a team;
  • Fluency in English (B2+) - Mandatory ;
  • Willing to move to Portugal with our support.


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV.

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

title: MS D365 CRM Functional Consultant
description:
We never request payment at any stage of our recruitment process, and we only contact candidates through official corporate accounts and platforms. If you are approached with any request for payment, it is likely fraudulent. Please verify whether the role you are interested in is posted on our official website.



About TMF Group

TMF Group is a leading global provider of high-value business services to clients operating and investing worldwide. We deliver specialized, business‑critical financial and administrative services that enable our clients to operate their corporate structures, finance vehicles and investment funds across multiple jurisdictions.



Discover the Role

We are seeking a CRM Business Analyst / CRM Functional Consultant who will play a key role in gathering business requirements and supporting implementations of Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365) . The ideal candidate is resourceful, detail‑oriented, self‑driven and committed to deeply understanding business needs and translating them into effective technical solutions.

Strong listening skills, collaboration, openness to feedback and a sense of ownership are essential to success in this role. If you are driven by challenge, enjoy going the extra mile and want to work with highly talented professionals, this is the opportunity for you.

If you are an experienced Microsoft D365 CRM Functional Consultant seeking dynamic projects and a collaborative team, we encourage you to apply.



Key Responsibilities

  • Gather and document business requirements in collaboration with stakeholders.
  • Implement Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM solutions tailored to business needs.
  • Configure and customize D365 CRM to meet functional requirements.
  • Work closely with technical teams to integrate CRM with other systems.
  • Participate in project planning, estimating and project management activities.
  • Deliver end‑user training and provide ongoing functional support.
  • Maintain up‑to‑date knowledge of new D365 CRM features and capabilities.
  • Mentor and guide junior consultants when needed.


Key Requirements

  • Experience in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM implementation and customization.
  • Experience with version 8.0 or later.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Experience developing custom workflows, entities and plugins using C# or .NET .
  • Strong understanding of D365 CRM’s data model, security model and configuration options.
  • Excellent analytical, problem‑solving and critical‑thinking skills.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently or in a team environment.



What’s in It for You?

Career Development

  • Opportunities for internal mobility and career progression.
  • Collaboration with global colleagues and exposure to international clients.
  • Continuous learning supported by the TMF Business Academy.

Making an Impact

  • Direct contribution to simplifying global business operations for our clients.
  • Opportunities to support local communities through our corporate social responsibility initiatives.

A Supportive Environment

  • A strong feedback culture that supports growth and engagement.
  • Flexibility to work from our offices or remotely, promoting work‑life balance.
  • An inclusive environment where people are empowered and encouraged to grow their careers.

At TMF Group, our people define who we are . We thrive on entrepreneurial spirit and value proactive professionals who bring passion, accountability and excellence to everything they do.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) .Net + Angular Sênior
description:
Quem somos nós?


Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.


Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .


Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:


  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?


Como .NET Developer na Builders você irá atuar no desenvolvimento de plataforma, produzindo e otimizando códigos para maior performance, escalabilidade e velocidade. Será responsável pela qualidade e funcionalidade das soluções implementadas.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa dominar:


  • Plataforma .NET Core (C#): Sólido conhecimento no desenvolvimento de aplicações utilizando .NET Core.
  • Angular: Experiência prática no desenvolvimento de interfaces com o framework Angular.
  • APIs Web (WebApi): Domínio na criação, consumo e manutenção de APIs RESTful.
  • Bancos de Dados: Conhecimento em bancos relacionais e não relacionais, como SQL Server, MongoDB e Oracle.
  • Testes Automatizados: Experiência na criação de testes de unidade e de integração utilizando ferramentas como xUnit, Moq ou NSubstitute.
  • Controle de Versão: Familiaridade com Git para versionamento de código.
  • Arquitetura de Software e Padrões de Projeto: Conhecimento em DDD (Domain-Driven Design), Design Patterns, arquitetura orientada a eventos (Event-Driven Architecture), microsserviços e práticas de integração e entrega contínua (CI/CD).
  • Boas Práticas de Desenvolvimento: Aplicação de princípios como Clean Code, SOLID, DRY (Don't Repeat Yourself), KISS (Keep It Simple, Stupid) e YAGNI (You Aren’t Gonna Need It).
  • Containers: Conhecimento em Docker para criação e gerenciamento de ambientes isolados.


Será um diferencial se você tiver também:


  • Conhecimento em tecnologias legadas para projetos de migração: Socket, SOAP;
  • Familiaridade com Práticas Ágeis;
  • Mensageria (RabbitMq, Azure Service Bus).


O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?

  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;
  • Auxílio Home-Office no cartão Caju;
  • Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju - um valor fléxivel para você usar como você quiser;
  • Plano de Saúde Nacional Porto Seguro (Plano Prata com apartamento e sem coparticipação) com 50% da mensalidade custeada pela Builders;
  • Assistência Odontológica pela Porto Seguro (Plano Bronze) com 100% da mensalidade paga pela Builders;
  • Auxílio Creche para crianças de até 72 meses;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Mental - acesso ao aplicativo Vida+;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Física - acesso ao aplicativo Gympass;
  • Seguro de vida.


Todas as nossas vagas são inclusivas e abertas a pessoas de todas as identidades de gênero, orientações sexuais, idades, etnias, culturas, origens, crenças, deficiências e outras diversidades. Acreditamos que a pluralidade enriquece nosso time e promove um ambiente de trabalho mais inovador e colaborativo.

Somos a maior exportadora de agroquímicos da China e TOP10 indústria agroquímica global, presente em mais de 100 países nos 5 continentes, com 6 fábricas próprias e um time de especialistas focados em solucionar as necessidades dos clientes.


Estamos em expansão no Brasil e buscamos profissionais comprometidos e que enxerguem na expansão uma oportunidade de construir e transformar.


Se você quer atuar em um ambiente dinâmico, com oportunidades reais de desenvolvimento e contribuir para transformar o futuro da proteção de cultivos no país, venha fazer parte da Rainbow Defensivos Agrícolas.


  • Especialista de Barter


PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES:


  • Construir e manter relacionamento próximo com tradings e demais parceiros de Barter, garantindo alternativas competitivas de originação;
  • Atuar em conjunto com o time de Marketing para desenvolver ofertas e campanhas de Barter alinhadas à estratégia comercial;
  • Apoiar diretamente o time comercial na execução das operações, desde a negociação até o fechamento do deal;
  • Analisar propostas, validar cálculos, condições, lastro agrícola e exposição de risco;
  • Garantir a acuracidade, integridade e arquivamento correto de todos os documentos (CPRs, contratos, termos, cessões, garantias etc.);
  • Monitorar o fluxo das operações no SAP, assegurando compliance com processos internos e SLAs;
  • Acompanhar o pós-negócio, garantindo aderência ao calendário de liquidação do Barter e Apoiar treinamentos internos e disseminação de conhecimento sobre Barter para o time comercial.



REQUISITOS:


  • Graduação em Agronomia, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Atuação prévia com operações de Barter, relacionamento com tradings, análise de CPRs e documentação contratual.
  • Conhecimento no mercado agrícola, culturas e produtividade, cálculos de equivalência (sacas), avaliação de risco, noções de crédito e compliance.
  • SAP e pacote Office (Excel avançado desejável).


DESEJÁVEL:

  • MBA/Pós em Agronegócio, Finanças ou Mercado de Commodities.
  • Inglês intermediário

title: Lead Java Developer - Relocation to Portugal
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • More than 10 years as a Back-End Developer with Java;
  • Experience with the latest versions of Java;
  • Solid experience with Spring Boot, Terraform, Kubernetes, Kafka, GraphQL and GitHub;
  • Work experience with Microsoft Cloud Azure;
  • Experience with leading complex initiatives and the collaboration with other teams to agree technical designs - Mandatory ;
  • Experience with Coaching and mentoring more junior engineers, influencing and improving the engineering practices within a team;
  • Fluency in English (B2+) - Mandatory ;
  • Willing to move to Portugal with our support.


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV.

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

title: Suporte Técnico de Inversor Fotovoltaico
description:
Descrição de Cargo:


Atendimento Técnico


1. Conhecimento dos inversores: É importante ter experiência com inversor, incluindo o entendimento de seus recursos, configurações, parâmetros e modos de operação.


2. Diagnóstico e solução de problemas: Ter habilidades em diagnóstico de falhas e solução de problemas é fundamental para o suporte técnico de inversores. Isso envolve a capacidade de identificar e solucionar problemas comuns, como falhas de comunicação, erros de configuração, sobrecargas, curtos-circuitos, entre outros.


3. Configuração: Em muitos casos, os inversores possuem interfaces de configuração, onde é necessário alterar parâmetros e ajustar as configurações de acordo com as necessidades dos clientes. Ter habilidades em configuração de inversores é valioso nesse contexto.


4. Habilidades de comunicação: Além do conhecimento técnico, é importante ter boas habilidades de comunicação para interagir com os clientes, entender suas necessidades, explicar soluções de problemas e fornecer suporte adequado. Isso inclui a capacidade de se comunicar claramente, ouvir atentamente e ser paciente.


Responsabilidades:


● Dar suporte técnico aos clientes à distância e de forma presencial (se necessário);

● Registrar os atendimentos diariamente;

● Preparar e aplicar treinamento;

● Participar de eventos e feiras do setor de energia atendendo ao público;

● Formação: Ensino Superior completo em Engenharia Elétrica

● Disponibilidade para Viajar pelo Brasil;

● Home Office, de Segunda a Sexta-Feira das 09:00 ás 18:00h

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
The Senior Machine Learning Engineer owns the development and deployment of machine learning solutions and influences the technical direction of their team. They will work closely with Product and Engineering partners in the development of the solution.


  • Lead the development and deployment of Machine Learning solutions to solve business problems.
  • Develop and maintain clean, efficient, and scalable code that meets industry standards
  • Analyze large datasets to extract actionable insights and make informed decisions.
  • Employ state-of-the-art Machine Learning methodologies and frameworks to develop robust and scalable models.
  • Influence technical direction and take ownership of key components of systems and solutions, ensuring that they meet the needs of the business.
  • Collaborate with key stakeholders in the development of data-driven solutions and deployable products.
  • Mentor junior team members to help establish team domain expertise.
  • Contribute to the companys intellectual property and technical leadership through patents and publications at top-tier conferences and journals.


Requirements:

  • 5+ years of industry experience in applied Machine Learning
  • Masters Degree or PhD in CS / ML or related field
  • 3+ years experience in building, deploying, and managing machine learning and deep learning models in production environments at scale
  • Deep understanding of ML best practices (A/B testing, training/serving pipelines, feature engineering etc), algorithms/techniques (gradient boosting, deep neural networks, optimization, regularization), and experiment design
  • Experience in at least one of these domains: price estimation, personalization, recommender systems, computer vision, fraud detection and authentication, marketing
  • Extensive experience in scientific libraries in Python (numpy, pandas) and Machine Learning tools and frameworks (Scikit-Learn, Tensorflow, Keras, PyTorch)
  • Strong data engineering skills and experience working with large scale datasets
  • Experience with big data tools (Apache Beam, Apache Kafka, Spark)
  • Experience with cloud technologies AWS, GCP or Azure

Fluency in Python, SQL


Preferred Requirements:

  • PhD preferred (CS, ML, AI or related field)
  • Background in applying ML techniques to solve real-world business problems in the retail sector.
  • Familiarity with MLOps tools and pipelines.
  • Impact-focused and passionate about delivering high-quality models.
  • Demonstrated leadership experience, with the ability to lead and inspire a team.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Full Stack Engineer

Location: Remote (Brazil)

Employment Type: PJ


We’re looking for Full Stack Engineer to join our Seller team — a group of passionate, collaborative developers building seamless on-platform experiences that help us acquire and activate high-value customers. You’ll work closely with Product, Marketing, and Engineering teams to deliver elegant, scalable solutions that drive engagement and business growth.


What You’ll Do

  • Produce high-quality, performant, and testable code that drives company-wide initiatives.
  • Lead the product development process — from ideation and prototyping to implementation and release.
  • Architect and build scalable systems supporting millions of users.
  • Contribute to design and architectural decisions shaping the future of our software systems.
  • Rapidly prototype and run A/B tests to validate and optimize user experiences.
  • Mentor teammates, conduct code reviews, and pair-program to support shared learning.
  • Collaborate closely with Product and Engineering Management to align technical solutions with business goals.


Tech Stacks

Languages

  • Elixir
  • Erlang
  • Ruby
  • JavaScript
  • TypeScript

Frameworks & Libraries

  • React
  • Next.js
  • GraphQL

Technologies & Architecture

  • Kafka
  • AWS / Lambda
  • Microservices
  • RESTful APIs
  • Event-based architecture

Databases

  • PostgreSQL
  • DynamoDB

Tools & Practices

  • Git / Version control
  • IDEs
  • Continuous integration & deployment tools
  • Testing frameworks and best practices
  • CMS (Prismic)
  • A/B Testing


What You Bring

Minimum Requirements

  • 7+ years of web application development experience with a proven track record of shipping successful products.
  • Strong background in writing reliable, maintainable code and building reusable component libraries.
  • Proficiency in at least one of the core languages or frameworks listed above.
  • Passion for testing, code quality, and continuous improvement.
  • Familiarity with RESTful APIs, Git, TypeScript, and remote deployment tools.
  • Experience with event-based architectures, GraphQL, and database fundamentals.
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Curiosity about retail/e-commerce and enthusiasm for sustainability and circular economies.

Preferred Requirements

  • Experience with React, HTML/CSS, and JavaScript.
  • Background in GraphQL and microservices architecture.
  • Experience developing eCommerce platforms or working with CMS tools (especially Prismic).
  • Familiarity with mobile development (iOS and/or Android) is a plus.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
The Senior Machine Learning Engineer owns the development and deployment of machine learning solutions and influences the technical direction of their team. They will work closely with Product and Engineering partners in the development of the solution.


  • Lead the development and deployment of Machine Learning solutions to solve business problems.
  • Develop and maintain clean, efficient, and scalable code that meets industry standards
  • Analyze large datasets to extract actionable insights and make informed decisions.
  • Employ state-of-the-art Machine Learning methodologies and frameworks to develop robust and scalable models.
  • Influence technical direction and take ownership of key components of systems and solutions, ensuring that they meet the needs of the business.
  • Collaborate with key stakeholders in the development of data-driven solutions and deployable products.
  • Mentor junior team members to help establish team domain expertise.
  • Contribute to the companys intellectual property and technical leadership through patents and publications at top-tier conferences and journals.


Requirements:

  • 5+ years of industry experience in applied Machine Learning
  • Masters Degree or PhD in CS / ML or related field
  • 3+ years experience in building, deploying, and managing machine learning and deep learning models in production environments at scale
  • Deep understanding of ML best practices (A/B testing, training/serving pipelines, feature engineering etc), algorithms/techniques (gradient boosting, deep neural networks, optimization, regularization), and experiment design
  • Experience in at least one of these domains: price estimation, personalization, recommender systems, computer vision, fraud detection and authentication, marketing
  • Extensive experience in scientific libraries in Python (numpy, pandas) and Machine Learning tools and frameworks (Scikit-Learn, Tensorflow, Keras, PyTorch)
  • Strong data engineering skills and experience working with large scale datasets
  • Experience with big data tools (Apache Beam, Apache Kafka, Spark)
  • Experience with cloud technologies AWS, GCP or Azure

Fluency in Python, SQL


Preferred Requirements:

  • PhD preferred (CS, ML, AI or related field)
  • Background in applying ML techniques to solve real-world business problems in the retail sector.
  • Familiarity with MLOps tools and pipelines.
  • Impact-focused and passionate about delivering high-quality models.
  • Demonstrated leadership experience, with the ability to lead and inspire a team.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Full Stack Engineer

Location: Remote (Brazil)

Employment Type: PJ


We’re looking for Full Stack Engineer to join our Seller team — a group of passionate, collaborative developers building seamless on-platform experiences that help us acquire and activate high-value customers. You’ll work closely with Product, Marketing, and Engineering teams to deliver elegant, scalable solutions that drive engagement and business growth.


What You’ll Do

  • Produce high-quality, performant, and testable code that drives company-wide initiatives.
  • Lead the product development process — from ideation and prototyping to implementation and release.
  • Architect and build scalable systems supporting millions of users.
  • Contribute to design and architectural decisions shaping the future of our software systems.
  • Rapidly prototype and run A/B tests to validate and optimize user experiences.
  • Mentor teammates, conduct code reviews, and pair-program to support shared learning.
  • Collaborate closely with Product and Engineering Management to align technical solutions with business goals.


Tech Stacks

Languages

  • Elixir
  • Erlang
  • Ruby
  • JavaScript
  • TypeScript

Frameworks & Libraries

  • React
  • Next.js
  • GraphQL

Technologies & Architecture

  • Kafka
  • AWS / Lambda
  • Microservices
  • RESTful APIs
  • Event-based architecture

Databases

  • PostgreSQL
  • DynamoDB

Tools & Practices

  • Git / Version control
  • IDEs
  • Continuous integration & deployment tools
  • Testing frameworks and best practices
  • CMS (Prismic)
  • A/B Testing


What You Bring

Minimum Requirements

  • 7+ years of web application development experience with a proven track record of shipping successful products.
  • Strong background in writing reliable, maintainable code and building reusable component libraries.
  • Proficiency in at least one of the core languages or frameworks listed above.
  • Passion for testing, code quality, and continuous improvement.
  • Familiarity with RESTful APIs, Git, TypeScript, and remote deployment tools.
  • Experience with event-based architectures, GraphQL, and database fundamentals.
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Curiosity about retail/e-commerce and enthusiasm for sustainability and circular economies.

Preferred Requirements

  • Experience with React, HTML/CSS, and JavaScript.
  • Background in GraphQL and microservices architecture.
  • Experience developing eCommerce platforms or working with CMS tools (especially Prismic).
  • Familiarity with mobile development (iOS and/or Android) is a plus.

description:
Código da vaga: 57654


Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.



  • Ei, profissional de Dynamics - venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!


O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?

Experiência comprovada em Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement , com foco no módulo Customer Service,

Conhecimento pratico em Power Apps e Power Automate

Experiência em Inteligência Artificial aplicada a projetos de Dynamics 365

Habilidade para traduzir requisitos de negócio em soluções técnicas

Boa comunicação, relacionamento interpessoal e capacidade de trabalho em equipe


Responsabilidades:

Levantamento de requisitos junto às áreas de negócio e stakeholders

Configuração e customização do módulo Customer Service no Dynamics 365

Desenvolvimento de soluções utilizando Power Apps e Power Automate

Aplicação de boas práticas para automação de processos e fluxos de trabalho

Colaboração com equipes técnicas e de negócio para garantir soluções alinhadas às necessidades

Documentação de processos e soluções.


Modelo 100% home office

CLT pela BRQ + Pacote de benefícios


- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

title: Salesforce Back-End Technical Lead, Brazil
description:
A OSF Digital é uma empresa líder em transformação digital com presença global em mais de 30 países e mais de 2000 funcionários. A nossa paixão é ajudar as empresas a tirar partido de soluções de comércio, marketing, vendas, serviços, análise, fidelização e experiência digital. Somos uma equipe em rápido crescimento, formada por pessoas diversas e apaixonadas por desempenho, tecnologia e satisfação do cliente. Na OSF Digital, damos grande ênfase ao equilíbrio entre vida profissional e pessoal e à satisfação dos funcionários, e nos esforçamos para criar uma cultura empresarial inovadora e aberta, ao mesmo tempo em que capacitamos as pessoas a contribuir de maneiras que tenham um impacto positivo em todos nós.


Responsabilidades:

  • Conduzir sessões de Refinamento e Grooming com clientes para entender necessidades, esclarecer dúvidas e garantir que todos os requisitos estejam bem definidos antes de solução, estimativas e planejamento.
  • Traduzir necessidades de negócio em tarefas técnicas claras e acionáveis, facilitando o alinhamento entre cliente, arquitetura e equipe técnica.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com o Solution Architect para orientar clientes sobre limitações técnicas, melhores práticas e opções de implementação, apoiando a tomada de decisões.
  • Validar soluções junto aos clientes, garantindo que os entregáveis atendam plenamente às expectativas e coletando feedback para melhorias contínuas.
  • Colaborar com o Project Manager para distribuir tarefas à equipe, revisar código e configurações, identificar problemas, assegurar aderência às melhores práticas e remover impedimentos técnicos.
  • Mentorizar desenvolvedores em tópicos técnicos e funcionalidades Salesforce, além de apoiar a equipe de QA na definição de cenários de teste, incluindo regressão quando necessário.



Requirements:

  • Experiência com Customization e Integration na plataforma Salesforce, incluindo Apex, Flows, Service Cloud e Experience Cloud (especialmente LWRs).
  • Vivência comprovada com integrações envolvendo SFCC, Oracle Integration Cloud e sistemas de POS como Tulip e TWC.
  • Capacidade de conduzir sessões de refinamento para definição de requisitos e traduzir necessidades de negócio em tarefas técnicas claras.
  • Experiência trabalhando em parceria com SA e PM, incluindo definição de soluções, orientação técnica, revisão de entregas e remoção de impedimentos.
  • Inglês avançado, com habilidade de comunicação efetiva com clientes e equipes internacionais.


A OSF Digital se orgulha de ser uma empresa que oferece oportunidades iguais, onde você pode trazer toda a sua personalidade para o trabalho. Junte-se a uma comunidade inclusiva e apaixonada de profissionais que ajudam a promover a transformação digital para empresas em todo o mundo. Na OSF Digital, acolhemos todas as pessoas e não discriminamos com base na identidade e expressão de gênero, raça, etnia, deficiência, orientação sexual, cor, religião, nacionalidade, idade, estado civil ou qualquer outra categoria protegida em qualquer uma das jurisdições em que atuamos.


English Version:


OSF Digital is a leading digital transformation firm with a global footprint in 30+ countries and over 2000+ employees. Our passion is in helping businesses leverage commerce, marketing, sales, service, analytics, loyalty, and digital experience solutions. We are a rapidly growing team of diverse individuals passionate about performance, technology, and customer satisfaction. At OSF Digital we place a key emphasis on work-life balance, employee satisfaction, and we strive to create a company culture that is innovative and open while empowering individuals to contribute in ways that positively impact us all.


Responsibilities:

  • Discusses with client to understand needs and ensure requirements are fully defined and captured before solutioning, estimating and assignment (Refinement and Grooming sessions).
  • Helps to translate business need into technical tasks.
  • Working hand in hand with SA Helps clients understand technical limitations, best practices, and options so they can make informed decisions.
  • Validates solutions with clients: Confirms that deliverables meet expectations, and gathers feedback for future iterations.
  • Works with PM to assign tasks to appropriate team members Reviews work: Provides code and configuration reviews, identifies issues , and ensures alignment with best practices Removes blockers: Helps resolve technical issues, clarifies questions with team members, and escalates problems when needed.
  • Coaches developers on technical topics and Salesforce features Supports QAs with applicable testing scenarios including regression tests where needed.


Requirements:

  • Experience with Salesforce Customization and Integration, including Apex, Flows, Service Cloud, and Experience Cloud (especially LWRs).
  • Proven experience with integrations involving SFCC, Oracle Integration Cloud, and POS systems such as Tulip and TWC.
  • Ability to lead refinement sessions to define requirements and translate business needs into clear technical tasks.
  • Experience working closely with SAs and PMs, including solution definition, technical guidance, review of deliverables, and removal of technical blockers.
  • Advanced English, with strong communication skills for interacting with clients and global teams.


OSF Digital is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, where you can bring your whole self to work. Join an inclusive and passionate community of professionals who help bring about digital transformation for businesses around the world. At OSF Digital, we welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, color, religion, national origin, age, marital status, or any other protected category in any of the jurisdictions in which we conduct business.
